item.title: Busójárás 2026: Mohács’ winter carnival returns with masks and bonfires!
item.description: From 12 to 17 February, the small Hungarian town of Mohács once again are filled with busó's. For six days, the city centre fills with masked figures, drums, folk music, market stalls, dancing — and the kind of controlled chaos that makes Busójárás feel less like a festival and more like a living tradition.
